title: Legacy stale-approval hint, docs and field naming (WCLI-137 opus round-3 follow-up)
description: Follow-up from the opus round-3 APPROVE at f16925d of ward-cli#258 (WCLI-137); all LOW. L1: the legacy hint (reporting.ts, text line and remedy) names 'ward init' even where init throws checkout_identity_unavailable (pruned linked-worktree gitdir, invalid checkout-id file); word it conditionally, or drop the register clause when the probe saw a .git entry but no resolvable git directory or a valid nonce file, and fix the test comment that says no step could work while expectInertLegacy asserts the ward-init hint for both cases. L2: amend ADR 0007 (89-98, 'every other record is reported as inert and unreachable') to point at ADR 0026's legacy arms; fix the StaleApprovalReport interface comments in reporting.ts (about 304-315: a non-clearable record is not always one 'nothing this build offers can reach'); correct the install-and-upgrade runbook (about 85-96) for the next release, since a plain approve at an unregistered checkout is refused with project_not_registered and the record is inert. L3: the legacy field is set only on legacy-and-unregistered records and so reads as 'is legacy'; rename it (registerHint) or set it on every legacy record and key the render on legacy, not clearable and unregistered. NIT-b: add an end-to-end test, doctor fails, ward profile approve, doctor passes, on a registered legacy record. Accepted residuals, recorded only: L4 (an inode-reusing re-clone that registered again takes the registered arm, so the doctor fails until the user approves in the new clone; the inherent legacy limit ADR 0026 accepts) and NIT-a (the legacy and no-nonce short-circuit in the identity lookup is an equivalent mutant, sameCheckout already rejects it, so it is not counted as tested).

acceptanceCriteria.text: The legacy hint no longer names ward init where init cannot run, and the contradicting test comment is fixed
ADR 0007, the StaleApprovalReport comments and the install-and-upgrade runbook describe the legacy arms as built
The legacy field's name or population matches what it means, and a test pins it
An end-to-end test shows doctor fail, ward profile approve, doctor pass on a registered legacy record

implementationNotes: Opus review of ward-cli#267: REQUEST CHANGES at efee5e6 (the runbook did not describe the legacy arms, and the probe read registrable true where init still fails on an unwritable directory, plus comment and test gaps), all folded in 71bdc7c. Opus delta review at 71bdc7c: APPROVE (verify MATCH), no HIGH or MEDIUM findings; each new test kills its mutant. Remaining LOWs filed as WCLI-145; the project_not_registered hint truthfulness and readBoundedFile O_NONBLOCK hardening filed as WCLI-144. L4 and NIT-a stay accepted residuals.
finalSummary: Landed in ward-cli#267. The doctor report names ward init for a legacy stale approval only where init can run (a read-only probe of the git directory, the nonce file and the ward entry, with a writability check); the legacy field is renamed registerHint and set only where the hint is shown; ADR 0007, ADR 0026 and the install-and-upgrade runbook describe the legacy arms as built; an end-to-end test shows doctor fail, ward profile approve, doctor pass. Doctor still fails on a legacy approval at a registered checkout (DEC-246 a3 Q2). Opus APPROVE at 71bdc7c; LOWs in WCLI-145, related items in WCLI-144.
